title: sqlite
responsibility: Preserves the generated-model SQLite factory address by delegating adapter construction to the canonical SqliteAdapter implementation.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.db
inputs.description: Caller-supplied synchronous SQLite handle with prepare(sql), exec(sql), and close(), used for the adapter’s database access. The factory injects this handle and does not open or close it.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.models
inputs.description: Each entry declares one table, an optional primary-key field name, and a map of application fields with SQLite field types; construction compiles each declaration and registers it by table name. The primary key defaults to id and must exist; table and column names must be unique valid identifiers, field types are limited to string, number, boolean, json, and blob, and the only field default is timestamp.

outputs.name: createSqliteAdapter
outputs.description: Returns a SqliteAdapter instance bound to the supplied synchronous database handle and model declarations. Construction validates and registers the declared models but does not open a database.

errors.name: Adapter construction failure
errors.description: The constructor throws a standard Error for invalid model declarations, including a missing primary-key field, duplicate table or column names, unsupported field types, and invalid SQL identifiers; this wrapper lets that error escape unchanged. The factory performs no asynchronous work and does not reject a promise.
